Trigger.Name: ON_VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
--
declare
 db_rowid VARCHAR2(30);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
--
 db_rowid := NULL;
 begin
 select rowid into db_rowid
 from rpt_parm_code
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id
 and parm_code = :system.cursor_value;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null;
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
--
 if nvl(db_rowid,'NULL') != nvl(:rpt_parm_code.rowid,'NULL')
 then
 message ('Err: Duplicate record for code : ' ||
 :rpt_parm_code.parm_code ) ;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-DELREC

declare
 no_of_recs number;
begin
 begin
 select count(*) into no_of_recs
 from rpt_parm_def
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id
 and parm_code = :rpt_parm_code.parm_code;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 if no_of_recs > 0
 then
 message ('Err: Can not delete as referenced by reports ');

 end if;
 delete_record;
end;
